title: Robotics Evaluation Atlas
note: Benchmarks catalogue and selected source-reported results from the Why Humanoid? master workbook. Results are transcribed from public sources and not independently replicated; selected results are not complete leaderboards; values use each source's native scale. Comparability groups are editorial aids, not proof of equal compute, data or statistical significance.

settings.label: Video or observations, no robot actuation
environments: Real-world environment observations; episodic and active variants

benchmarks.name: LIBERO
benchmarks.description: Benchmark for knowledge transfer in multitask and lifelong robot manipulation learning.
benchmarks.tasks: 130 tasks in four suites; LIBERO-90 pretraining and LIBERO-10 downstream evaluation
benchmarks.metrics: Task success; suite-specific evaluation
benchmarks.protocol: Use the published suite, initial states and train/test protocol.
benchmarks.review_status: Primary catalogue and dataset role checked
benchmarks.limitations: Simulation performance is not proof of full-body humanoid or commercial performance.
benchmarks.key_finding: Four suites isolate transfer under different task changes.

benchmarks.name: CALVIN
benchmarks.description: Benchmark for language-conditioned, long-horizon robot manipulation policies.
benchmarks.tasks: Long-horizon manipulation across environment splits
benchmarks.metrics: Long-horizon and single-task evaluation; full metric definitions in repository
benchmarks.protocol: Use the published evaluation sequence and dataset split.
benchmarks.source_locator: README: Download dataset, Evaluating a Policy
benchmarks.review_status: Primary catalogue and dataset role checked
benchmarks.limitations: Environment/control/version changes affect comparison; not a whole-body humanoid test.
benchmarks.key_finding: Evaluate consecutive task completion under the published environment split.

benchmarks.name: RoboEval
benchmarks.description: Simulation benchmark for structured evaluation of bimanual manipulation with skill-level diagnostics.
benchmarks.tasks: 8 base tasks; 30 variations; 3,000+ human demonstrations
benchmarks.metrics: Task success and diagnostic behavioural metrics
benchmarks.protocol: Skill-specific stages and task variations.
benchmarks.review_status: Primary catalogue and dataset role checked
benchmarks.limitations: Binary success alone hides coordination failures; claims attributed to project.
benchmarks.key_finding: Skill-level diagnostics complement binary success; diagnostics are not safety certification.

benchmarks.name: RoboArena
benchmarks.description: Distributed real-world evaluation of generalist robot policies.
benchmarks.tasks: Not independently rechecked
benchmarks.metrics: Not independently rechecked
benchmarks.protocol: Detailed protocol review pending.
benchmarks.source_locator: Existing Datasets and Software catalogue entries
benchmarks.review_status: Imported catalogue; protocol review pending
benchmarks.limitations: No benchmark-specific dataset record retained until a reusable corpus is verified.
benchmarks.key_finding: Distributed evaluation needs policy, task and judging protocol provenance.

benchmarks.name: Polaris
benchmarks.description: Real-to-sim reconstruction framework and evaluation suite for generalist robot policies.
benchmarks.tasks: Reconstructed real scenes and task-policy pairs
benchmarks.metrics: Normalized task progress
benchmarks.protocol: Project reports 20 real and 50 simulated rollouts per policy-task pair.
benchmarks.review_status: Primary project page checked
benchmarks.limitations: Reported real-sim correlation does not make arbitrary simulations interchangeable with real tests.
benchmarks.key_finding: Normalized progress paired in simulation and reality; correlation is setup-specific. Attachment r=0.90 not numerically revalidated.

benchmarks.name: REALM
benchmarks.description: Real-to-sim validated simulation benchmark for generalization in robotic manipulation.
benchmarks.tasks: 7 skills; 15 perturbation factors; 4,000+ objects
benchmarks.metrics: Protocol-specific task performance; see current evaluation documentation
benchmarks.protocol: Use the matching REALM release and task set.
benchmarks.review_status: Primary project page checked
benchmarks.limitations: Release changes and revised leaderboards must be versioned; no new cross-model scores imported.
benchmarks.key_finding: Systematic perturbations test generalization under a defined release.

benchmarks.name: Physics IQ
benchmarks.description: Benchmark and evaluation dataset for physical understanding in generative video models.
benchmarks.tasks: Solid mechanics, fluids, optics, thermodynamics and magnetism
benchmarks.metrics: Physics-IQ score
benchmarks.protocol: Use the published benchmark videos and scoring implementation.
benchmarks.review_status: Primary catalogue and dataset role checked
benchmarks.limitations: Not a robot manipulation, safety or deployment test.
benchmarks.key_finding: Original and Verified variants have different prompts/metrics and must remain separate.
benchmarks.results_coverage: Selected Original and Verified results extracted

benchmarks.name: RoboDojo
benchmarks.description: Unified simulation-and-real benchmark for evaluating generalist robot manipulation policies.
benchmarks.embodiment: Robot arms; sim and remote real
benchmarks.tasks: 42 simulation tasks; 18 real-world tasks
benchmarks.metrics: Score and success rate; capability-specific measures
benchmarks.protocol: Use the same sim/real task suite, embodiment and track; remote real-world evaluation is separate.
benchmarks.review_status: Primary project page checked
benchmarks.limitations: Humanoid whole-body extensions are listed as future extensions, not current measured capability. Dataset availability not established in this pass.
benchmarks.key_finding: A unified interface does not make simulation and hardware scores interchangeable.

benchmarks.name: Poke and Wiggle
benchmarks.description: Real-robot Reality Check leaderboard using the PAW-GEN-10-Agentic task suite.
benchmarks.embodiment: Franka FR3 arms; bimanual tasks included
benchmarks.tasks: 10 task environments with nominal/interpolation/extrapolation conditions
benchmarks.metrics: Success, task progress, execution quality/time, smoothness, safe failure and contact force
benchmarks.protocol: Compare the same metric, environment and placement condition; published confidence intervals apply.
benchmarks.source_locator: Reality Check Leaderboard; Spatial Generalization; metric definitions
benchmarks.review_status: Primary project page checked
benchmarks.limitations: Different metrics and placement conditions are not interchangeable; no model ranking copied.
benchmarks.key_finding: Training placement performance can conceal a large drop outside the training range.

benchmarks.name: RoboColosseum
benchmarks.description: Distributed real-world benchmark ecosystem for robot policies, with rollout datasets and model resources.
benchmarks.tasks: Multiple robot embodiments and everyday tasks
benchmarks.metrics: Per-track metrics; detailed protocol review pending
benchmarks.protocol: Keep robot embodiment, task and track explicit.
benchmarks.source_locator: Organisation card; rollout data and leaderboard links
benchmarks.review_status: Primary catalogue and dataset role checked
benchmarks.limitations: An ecosystem/portal, not one dataset. Dataset licences must be checked per repository.
benchmarks.key_finding: Distributed evaluation ecosystem; each track and robot requires its own protocol.

benchmarks.name: MolmoSpaces-Bench
benchmarks.description: Benchmark ecosystem and leaderboard for robot navigation and manipulation, paired with open environments and assets.
benchmarks.tasks: Navigation, manipulation and long-horizon tasks
benchmarks.metrics: End success rate with reported 95% confidence intervals; joint jerk
benchmarks.protocol: Keep task, embodiment, action space, training data and specialist/generalist filters explicit.
benchmarks.review_status: Primary catalogue and dataset role checked
benchmarks.limitations: Reported sim-to-real correlation is project evidence, not universal validation.
benchmarks.key_finding: Leaderboard filters distinguish training data and policy types.

benchmarks.name: SpatialBench
benchmarks.description: Spatial-reasoning benchmark for multimodal AI models using 2D path tracing and 3D mental rotation tasks.
benchmarks.tasks: 50 problems: 25 3D mental-rotation questions and 25 2D path-tracing questions
benchmarks.metrics: Site labels leaderboard Pass@1 (%); methodology defines a probability-normalized composite
benchmarks.protocol: 3D has 4 choices and 2D 20 endpoints. Final = (S_2D + S_3D^2.16) / 2. Record tool access separately.
benchmarks.review_status: Primary project page and methodology checked
benchmarks.limitations: Not a robot benchmark. Small sample; site gives random-run interval about 0.5%-12.3%. Human baseline and scores are project-reported; tool-enabled and no-tool runs differ.
benchmarks.key_finding: 2D/3D composite with tool-access conditions; not a humanoid performance score.

benchmarks.name: RLBench
benchmarks.description: Simulation environment for visual manipulation learning and task generalization.
benchmarks.embodiment: Fixed arm; Panda default; swappable arms
benchmarks.tasks: Versioned task sets; FS10/25/50/95 train tasks plus five test tasks
benchmarks.metrics: Task success under the selected task set and action mode
benchmarks.protocol: Pin task set, observations, action mode and simulator version.
benchmarks.source_locator: README: Few-Shot Learning; Multi-Task Learning; Gotchas
benchmarks.review_status: Primary project overview checked; detailed numerical extraction pending
benchmarks.limitations: Project-reported scope; not independent replication. Conditions and versions limit comparisons.
benchmarks.key_finding: Breadth of tasks enables few-shot evaluation; action modes and task sets change the experiment.

benchmarks.name: SIMPLER
benchmarks.description: Simulation evaluation calibrated to common real robot manipulation setups.
benchmarks.tasks: Google Robot and WidowX; paired evaluations across approximately 1,500 episodes in each domain
benchmarks.metrics: Task success; Pearson r; Mean Maximum Rank Violation (lower is better)
benchmarks.protocol: Keep robot, visual matching/variant aggregation, task and policy checkpoint explicit.
benchmarks.source_locator: Metrics for Real-to-Sim Evaluation; Applications; Gallery
benchmarks.review_status: Primary project overview checked; detailed numerical extraction pending
benchmarks.limitations: Project-reported scope; not independent replication. Conditions and versions limit comparisons.
benchmarks.key_finding: Project validates a simulation proxy for selected setups; ranking consistency is distinct from raw correlation.

benchmarks.name: ManiSkill3
benchmarks.description: GPU-parallel robot simulation and benchmark framework for multiple embodiments.
benchmarks.tasks: Versioned environments across fixed arms, mobile manipulators and humanoids
benchmarks.metrics: Task-specific success and rewards; simulator throughput is a separate infrastructure metric
benchmarks.protocol: Pin environment ID/version, robot, observations, controller and evaluation budget.
benchmarks.review_status: Primary project overview checked; detailed numerical extraction pending
benchmarks.limitations: Project-reported scope; not independent replication. Conditions and versions limit comparisons.
benchmarks.key_finding: A framework covering many tasks, not one scalar test; collection FPS does not measure policy competence.

benchmarks.name: VLABench
benchmarks.description: Language-conditioned manipulation benchmark testing knowledge, intentions and long-horizon reasoning.
benchmarks.embodiment: Robot manipulation; non-interactive VLM track has no executed robot action
benchmarks.tasks: 100 task categories (60 primitive, 40 composite); 2,000+ objects
benchmarks.metrics: Interactive progress and success; non-interactive skill-sequence DAG matching
benchmarks.protocol: Separate interactive execution from non-interactive planning; pin task split and method type.
benchmarks.review_status: Primary project overview checked; detailed numerical extraction pending
benchmarks.limitations: Project-reported scope; not independent replication. Conditions and versions limit comparisons.
benchmarks.key_finding: Project reports weaknesses in generalization and planning; a planning score is not an execution score.

benchmarks.name: RoboTwin 2.0
benchmarks.description: Bimanual manipulation benchmark and scalable synthetic demonstration generator.
benchmarks.tasks: 50 simulation tasks; object library of 731 instances across 147 categories
benchmarks.metrics: Task success under specified task and randomization conditions
benchmarks.protocol: Leaderboard: Aloha-AgileX; 50 clean demos x 50 tasks; 100 trials/task; clean-to-clean and clean-to-random; separate depth input and co-train/single-task SFT.
benchmarks.review_status: Primary project overview checked; detailed numerical extraction pending
benchmarks.limitations: Project-reported scope; not independent replication. Conditions and versions limit comparisons.
benchmarks.key_finding: Automated task-code generation and domain randomization scale training diversity; generation volume is not a policy result.

benchmarks.name: BEHAVIOR-1K
benchmarks.description: Long-horizon household activity benchmark with mobile manipulation and rich object states.
benchmarks.embodiment: Mobile manipulation; selected robot depends on release/track
benchmarks.tasks: 1,000 activities; 50 scenes; 10,000+ objects (project scope)
benchmarks.metrics: Task-specific goal satisfaction and challenge metrics; exact release protocol required
benchmarks.protocol: Distinguish full 1K activity inventory from each challenge's evaluated subset and robot setup.
benchmarks.source_locator: Home: activities, scenes and OmniGibson; challenge navigation
benchmarks.review_status: Primary project overview checked; detailed numerical extraction pending
benchmarks.limitations: Project-reported scope; not independent replication. Conditions and versions limit comparisons.
benchmarks.key_finding: Task specification includes state changes and realistic household interactions; catalogue size is not evaluated success.

benchmarks.name: GenSim2
benchmarks.description: LLM-assisted articulated-task and robot-data generation framework with policy evaluation.
benchmarks.tasks: Up to 100 articulated tasks and 200 objects (authors' report)
benchmarks.metrics: Policy task success; generalization and sim-to-real experiments
benchmarks.protocol: Separate pipeline/data generation results from policy results; identify train/test objects and real-data mixing.
benchmarks.source_locator: Abstract; Generated Task Library; Real-Robot Experiments
benchmarks.review_status: Primary project overview checked; detailed numerical extraction pending
benchmarks.limitations: Project-reported scope; not independent replication. Conditions and versions limit comparisons.
benchmarks.key_finding: Main contribution is scalable task/data generation; the reported 20% improvement lacks an unambiguous unit in the abstract and is not imported as points.

benchmarks.name: OpenEQA
benchmarks.description: Open-vocabulary embodied question answering from episodic memory or active exploration.
benchmarks.environment: Real-world environment observations; episodic and active variants
benchmarks.embodiment: VLM / embodied agent; active exploration optional
benchmarks.tasks: 1,600+ human questions from 180+ real environments
benchmarks.metrics: LLM-powered answer evaluation; exact evaluator and scoring version required
benchmarks.protocol: Separate episodic-memory and active-exploration tracks; pin observations and judge.
benchmarks.review_status: Primary project overview checked; detailed numerical extraction pending
benchmarks.limitations: Project-reported scope; not independent replication. Conditions and versions limit comparisons.
benchmarks.key_finding: Understanding a scene well enough to answer questions does not establish manipulation or locomotion competence.

benchmarks.name: HumanoidBench
benchmarks.description: Simulation benchmark for humanoid whole-body locomotion and dexterous manipulation.
benchmarks.embodiment: Experiments: Unitree H1 with two Shadow Hands; other robot/end-effector options
benchmarks.tasks: 27 whole-body control tasks
benchmarks.metrics: Task-specific returns and success thresholds; pin task definition
benchmarks.protocol: Pin robot, hand/gripper, observations, low-level skill access and training budget.
benchmarks.source_locator: Abstract; Simulation Environment; Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
benchmarks.review_status: Primary project overview checked; detailed numerical extraction pending
benchmarks.limitations: Project-reported scope; not independent replication. Conditions and versions limit comparisons.
benchmarks.key_finding: Authors report flat RL struggles and hierarchical policies benefit from pretrained skills; no hardware deployment is demonstrated here.

benchmarks.name: ARNOLD
benchmarks.description: Language-grounded manipulation of continuous object goal states.
benchmarks.tasks: 8 tasks; generalization to goal states, objects and scenes
benchmarks.metrics: Continuous-state goal evaluation; task-specific tolerance and success criteria
benchmarks.protocol: Record requested state, tolerance, task and unseen-state/object/scene split.
benchmarks.review_status: Primary project overview checked; detailed numerical extraction pending
benchmarks.limitations: Project-reported scope; not independent replication. Conditions and versions limit comparisons.
benchmarks.key_finding: Tests how precisely an instruction specifies a continuous target; binary completion alone omits that distinction.
